$doc: Feedback & communication log between the maintainer and Claude about MQ Research Gate. The repo-side, chat-extractable mirror of the conversation. The live version is the feedback threads in the published docs/atlas.html (backed by the artifact db capability); Claude reconciles new entries here.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Monetization Phases A–D shipped on branch feature/monetization-entitlements: plan/entitlement layer + 402 gate, community moved live-remote with the local mirror removed, publishing gated. MCP kept local (Phase E deferred by decision — the cloud has none of the corpus). This atlas (docs/atlas.json for AI, docs/atlas.html for humans) is the shared map. Leave feedback per section in the published page or here; I read it back.

entries.author: Maintainer
entries.text: Let's make things simple first: migrate quran.db to Postgres.

entries.author: Claude
entries.text: Corpus step 1 done on branch feature/corpus-postgres: quran.db is in Postgres schema `corpus` (294,804 rows, 18 s) and verified exact on every row of every table, the view, FKs and indexes. Text is COLLATE "C" so Arabic sorts as it does in SQLite — the هدي forms query returns the identical answer in identical order on both. Nothing reads the Postgres copy yet; step 2 ports the query layer (sync→async) and decides Arabic full-text. Open question for you: should cloud corpus reads be free, or plan-gated?
